errors.evidence: Description states ~24 for mBERT-B₂ in IE-Indic whereas the chart shows approximately 18.
Description states ~21 for XLM-B₂ in IE-Indic whereas the chart shows approximately 16.
Description states 'near-zero effects' for Isolate and Uralic, while they show varying effect values above zero across different models.
